doc.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007

title: Monk Rowe opens the interview
summary: Rowe introduces himself and guest Leo Rayhill, who thanks him for the Archive.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are on the Hamilton College campus for the Jazz Archive, filming today. And I’m very pleased to have Mr. Leo Rayhill, Class of ’49, as my guest.
I’m delighted to be here. You’ve done such a wonderful job with the Archives, it’s unreal.
